parameters.content:
## Reel factory: new UGC reel
Fill the form **New UGC Reel** (links to the product pictures and to 1-5 winning reels, the language, the approved facts). The job is saved in **dtj_reel_jobs**, then the run pauses at **Wait for Claude Code: Reel**.

On the reel VPS, the person on duty runs Claude Code in the dtj-agency-automation folder and says "handle the Claude Code trigger in n8n" (or "listen for reel requests"). Claude makes the reel in the logged-in browser (ChatGPT, Google Flow), checks every take, removes the Flow sparkle, edits, captions, and posts the result here. Nothing is posted to Meta.

Source in git: `n8n/reel-factory/` and `services/reel-factory/`.
